## Invitations

The outreach resulted in 6968 invitations being issued. Of those invited, 5378 attended, representing an attendance rate of 77.2 per cent. This provides the overall position for the reporting period and supports monitoring of participation across future outreach activity.

Attendance tends to dip in winter and recover in spring. This pattern should be considered when reviewing the level of response and planning communications.

## Contact

SMS communication was used for 5919 invitations. A reminder message was also sent to 5919 people. The use of both initial SMS contact and reminder messages formed part of the communication activity supporting attendance.

The figures above provide a summary of invitations, attendance and contact activity. Prepared by G. Evans.
